'''2012 Bespin Regionals Calvin Kurten LS There Is Good In Him''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Calvin Kurten]] at [[2012 Bespin Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
